overview.Name: Liminatus Pharma, Inc.
overview.Description: Liminatus Pharma, Inc., a pre-clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in the development of cancer therapies in the United States. It develops IBA101, a humanized anti CD47 monoclonal antibody, which is in Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of advanced solid cancers, including non-small cell lung cancer. The company was founded in 2018 and is based in Cerritos, California.
